name: PKHD1 ciliary IPT domain containing fibrocystin/polyductin

function.text: PKHD1 encodes fibrocystin. Annotated molecular activities include signaling receptor activity. It participates in cell-cell adhesion and homeostatic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease (autosomal recessive); polycystic kidney disease 4 (autosomal recessive).
